title: Price both P104 exterior port retirements under joint coding
body:
On Clear1nsight's pinned #7786 word, chart 278 can pool the payloads of slots 95887 and 100336 and retire either slot while preserving all 387 exterior terminal operators. Either choice disturbs two of receiver 127's outputs. The minimum additional repair tariff is exactly **$L\,p(7)$ for $L$ independent calls**, even with arbitrary joint rational-linear coding of the extra messages, with the surviving native routes and payloads frozen after the merger.

The public input $x_{674}=1,\ x_{722}=-1$ makes all surviving paid observations at ranks three and above vanish. Independent copies of that input force $L$ scalar crossings at each of seven rank cuts. A direct grade-seven delivery attains the bound. The 56-chart interval contains 933 minimum-total-grade paths. For the 48 enrolled calls, after credit for the retired slot, the grade-one retirement **increases** signed cost by 285.472830172972… and the grade-five retirement increases it by 94.9667971064257…. Both direct reconstructions reproduce all 1,289 terminals. More generally, every exterior-preserving change to the ten outgoing payloads at the original ingress has two free forms $h,j$. A rank-912 certificate shows that the minimum number of additional linear receiver deposits is exactly $\dim\operatorname{span}(h,j)$, taking values zero, one or two.

This checks the exterior-null direction identified in #7814 on the actual paid profile and narrows the remaining search to edits that change more native stock or readers. The result neither selects a new word nor changes the repository's conditional exponent. The source word and earlier paid-cut evidence are from Clear1nsight (#7786, #7795, #7804), built on Ali Romman's #7776 construction.

All 6 registered CPython 3.12 checks passed in the checkout and in a read-only, Git-free export of the submitted commit. The source-history, committed-byte, mode and export-inventory checks passed.
